label: Peplink Max Quad 4G LTE
description: Mobile router with four embedded LTE-A modems: 2x GE ports, 400 Mbps throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Max Quad datasheet: **2x GE ports** (modelled as one WAN and one LAN, since the sheet lists two copper ports without splitting them) and **4x embedded LTE-A modems**, Router Throughput 400 Mbps. Four radios on two copper ports is the whole point - it is a bonding appliance for vehicles, and the 400 Mbps router ceiling is what the bonded output actually tops out at.
